title: Santo Domingo: the first Spanish city in the Americas
goal: Tell the early history of Santo Domingo with the passive with *ser* (*fue fundada*, *fueron construidos*).
grammar: the passive with ser, applied to colonial Santo Domingo

items: I can say who founded, built or created something with *fue* / *fueron* + participle.
I can say what happened in Santo Domingo in 1502, 1538 and 1511.
I can use the new words for palace, friar, sermon and papal bull.
